quests.question: The regulatory authority ___ approve any merger that creates a dominant market position.
quests.hint: Antitrust law prevents dominant market positions - mandatory rejection.
quests.explanation: Antitrust law exists specifically to stop this kind of market dominance before it happens. 'Must approve' (in its negative form here) reflects that regulators have no real discretion once dominance is shown.

quests.question: Had the insurer been notified promptly, the claim ___ have been processed far more quickly.
quests.hint: Notifying an insurer promptly tends to speed up how quickly a claim moves.
quests.explanation: Insurance claims often stall simply because of a delayed notification. 'Would have been processed far more quickly' points to the faster timeline that prompt notice would have unlocked.

quests.question: The management ___ have taken a more consultative approach to implementing the restructuring.
quests.hint: Poor restructuring outcomes indicate consultation was needed.
quests.explanation: Restructuring tends to go smoother when the people affected are consulted along the way, not just informed afterward. 'Should have taken a more consultative approach' points to that missing step.

quests.question: The contract ___ be silent on force majeure - any such clause must be expressly included.
quests.hint: Contracts require explicit force majeure clauses - implied terms are insufficient.
quests.explanation: Some protections don't exist unless they're spelled out in black and white. 'May not be silent' reflects that force majeure can't simply be assumed - it has to be written in.

quests.question: Without the advanced warning system, the community ___ have had no time to evacuate.
quests.hint: Advanced warning is often what turns a disaster into a close call.
quests.explanation: Evacuations depend entirely on having enough notice to act. 'Would have had no time' pictures the far worse scenario that the warning system prevented.

quests.question: The project director ___ have escalated the budget overruns to the board at a much earlier stage.
quests.hint: Budget overruns require immediate board notification.
quests.explanation: A board that finds out about a budget overrun late has already lost time it needed. 'Should have escalated' points to how much sooner that notification should have come.

quests.question: An independent valuation ___ be obtained before any sale of public assets to private entities.
quests.hint: Selling public assets requires independent valuation - mandatory.
quests.explanation: Selling public assets without an independent check invites exactly the kind of underselling the public needs protecting from. 'Must be obtained' reflects that this step isn't optional.

quests.question: Had the warning signs been heeded, the institutional failure ___ have been averted entirely.
quests.hint: Heeding a warning helps, but it doesn't guarantee the worst outcome is avoided.
quests.explanation: Even well-heeded warnings don't always stop a failure completely. 'Might have been averted' keeps this as a real possibility rather than a certainty.

quests.question: The prosecutor ___ have presented the exculpatory evidence to the defence well in advance of trial.
quests.hint: Disclosure of exculpatory evidence is a fundamental prosecutorial duty.
quests.explanation: Sitting on evidence that could help the defence isn't a grey area in criminal law - it's a serious breach. 'Should have presented' names the disclosure duty that was missed.

quests.question: The legislation ___ provide a clear definition of terms used to avoid ambiguity in its application.
quests.hint: Legislative clarity requires precise definitions - mandatory drafting standard.
quests.explanation: Legislation that leaves its own terms undefined tends to generate exactly the kind of disputes it was meant to prevent. 'Must provide' reflects that definitions aren't optional polish - they're structural.

quests.question: Without the innovation in vaccine technology, the pandemic ___ have continued for several more years.
quests.hint: Vaccine breakthroughs tend to shorten the length of an outbreak considerably.
quests.explanation: Pandemics without a medical breakthrough tend to drag on far longer. 'Would have continued' pictures the extended timeline that the vaccine cut short.

quests.question: As a trustee, she ___ act in the best interests of the beneficiaries at all times, not her own.
quests.hint: A trustee's whole role centres on someone else's interests, not her own.
quests.explanation: 'Must act' expresses an ongoing, binding duty. Fiduciary responsibility means a trustee's own interests never take priority over those of the people she is managing assets for.

quests.question: The service provider ___ comply with the applicable data protection legislation at all times.
quests.hint: Data protection compliance is a continuous, mandatory obligation.
quests.explanation: Data protection compliance isn't a box ticked once and forgotten - it has to hold up continuously. 'Must comply' reflects that ongoing, unbroken obligation.

quests.question: Had the financial model been stress-tested more rigorously, the vulnerabilities ___ have been identified.
quests.hint: More demanding stress tests tend to surface weaknesses that milder ones miss.
quests.explanation: Weak spots in a financial model often stay hidden until they're tested hard enough to show up. 'Would have been identified' points to what rigorous testing would have revealed.

quests.question: The ombudsman ___ have investigated the complaints without delay - many were left unresolved for years.
quests.hint: Prompt investigation of complaints is the ombudsman's core duty.
quests.explanation: Complaints left unresolved for years are a strong sign that something in the process moved too slowly. 'Should have investigated without delay' names that failure directly.

quests.question: Under no circumstances ___ classified information be shared with unauthorised personnel.
quests.hint: Absolute prohibition on sharing classified information.
quests.explanation: Classified material and unauthorised hands are meant to never mix, full stop. 'Shall not be shared' gives that rule the categorical, no-exceptions phrasing it needs.

quests.question: Without the structural reinforcements, the building ___ have collapsed in the earthquake.
quests.hint: Structural reinforcement is often the deciding factor in whether a building survives a quake.
quests.explanation: Earthquakes test a building's structure directly, and weak points tend to fail first. 'Would have collapsed' pictures the outcome that the reinforcements were specifically built to prevent.

quests.question: The regulatory sandbox ___ have been established with clearer exit criteria for participating firms.
quests.hint: Unclear exit criteria undermine the effectiveness of a regulatory sandbox.
quests.explanation: A sandbox without a clear way out can trap participants in permanent light-touch regulation. 'Should have been established with clearer exit criteria' names that design flaw.

quests.question: The court ___ not make an order that has the effect of punishing a person without due process.
quests.hint: Due process is constitutionally protected - absolute prohibition.
quests.explanation: Due process protections are usually treated as close to untouchable in constitutional law. 'Shall not make' reflects that firm, binding limit on judicial power.

quests.question: Had the scientific advisory committee been more independent, its recommendations ___ have carried greater weight.
quests.hint: More independence tends to make expert recommendations harder to dismiss.
quests.explanation: Recommendations carry more weight when they come from a source with no obvious stake in the outcome. 'Would have carried greater weight' points to the credibility that independence would have added.

quests.question: The market authority ___ have acted upon the evidence of price-fixing without waiting for a complaint.
quests.hint: Regulators must act on evidence of market abuse proactively.
quests.explanation: Waiting for a formal complaint before acting on clear evidence of price-fixing is waiting too long. 'Should have acted' points to the proactive response that didn't happen.

quests.question: The principal ___ not delegate core fiduciary responsibilities to agents without proper oversight.
quests.hint: Core fiduciary duties cannot be delegated without oversight.
quests.explanation: Fiduciary duties tend to follow the person, not disappear the moment work gets delegated. 'Must not delegate' reflects that oversight has to travel with the responsibility.

quests.question: Without the sustained advocacy of civil society, the reforms ___ never have reached the legislative agenda.
quests.hint: Sustained public pressure can put an ignored issue back on the agenda.
quests.explanation: Reforms rarely land on a legislative agenda purely on their own merits. 'Would never have reached' pictures the obscurity the reforms would have stayed in without that sustained pressure.

quests.question: Some analysts believe the supervisory board ___ have exercised greater scrutiny over the expense claims, though the internal review remains confidential.
quests.hint: Without a public review, this stays an educated guess rather than a fact.
quests.explanation: 'Might have exercised' keeps this as a plausible but unproven claim. Since the internal review is confidential, outsiders can only speculate, which is exactly the kind of uncertainty 'might' is built for.

quests.question: The whistleblower protection framework ___ cover all forms of retaliation, including demotion and exclusion.
quests.hint: Comprehensive whistleblower protection is a legal obligation.
quests.explanation: Narrow whistleblower protection tends to leave exactly the gaps that discourage people from ever coming forward. 'Must cover' reflects why the scope has to be comprehensive.

quests.question: Had the mediation process been properly facilitated, the dispute ___ have been resolved within weeks.
quests.hint: Good facilitation helps disputes move faster, though a quick outcome isn't guaranteed.
quests.explanation: Even well-facilitated mediation doesn't always move quickly. 'Might have been resolved within weeks' keeps the faster outcome realistic rather than certain.

quests.question: The licensing authority ___ have conducted a more thorough background check on the applicant.
quests.hint: Background checks are a core duty of any licensing authority.
quests.explanation: A licence is a serious grant of trust, and background checks are how that trust gets earned. 'Should have conducted a more thorough background check' points to a step that fell short.

quests.question: The terms of the settlement ___ remain confidential unless both parties consent to disclosure.
quests.hint: Settlement language favours the most formal, binding modal available.
quests.explanation: 'Shall remain confidential' uses the binding, formal register typical of settlement agreements. 'Shall' in legal drafting expresses a firm contractual obligation on both parties.

quests.question: Without the public inquiry, the systematic failings in the care system ___ have remained hidden.
quests.hint: Public inquiries are often the reason hidden problems finally come to light.
quests.explanation: Systemic failings in institutions don't tend to surface on their own. 'Would have remained hidden' pictures the concealment that only the public inquiry exposed.

quests.question: The oversight committee ___ have demanded more frequent reporting from the executive during the crisis.
quests.hint: A crisis demands more, not less, oversight and reporting.
quests.explanation: A crisis calls for more scrutiny, not less, yet that's often when reporting quietly loosens. 'Should have demanded more frequent reporting' points to that gap in oversight.
